title: Temporal isolation gate and soft tombstone hotpatch for regional surge dampening
author: Sofia Nguyen
description: Motivation: during a short-lived regional surge we observed repeated node rejoin/evac cycles that amplified downstream SLO violations and caused KV-cache churn. This PR introduces a Temporal Isolation Gate (TIG) and a soft tombstone marker to break oscillation loops and allow graceful backfill without immediate re-admission. Summary of changes: 1) core: add TemporalIsolationGate in the routing layer to delay re-admit attempts for nodes/tenants within a configurable SLO window; 2) eviction: introduce 'soft tombstone' metadata on connections and KV leases that marks ephemeral quarantine without full eviction, reducing KV drain churn; 3) controlplane: surface tombstone/quiet-window state in the health API and add a TTL-backed tombstone reconciler to ensure automatic clear after the configured window; 4) telemetry: emit new metrics and structured spans (tombstone.count, tombstone.reason, tig.window_ms, tenant.quiet_window) and add corresponding SLO alert hooks; 5) helm/ops: expose the TIG feature flag and default quiet-window config (canary-friendly defaults). Rollout plan: gated by the feature flag 'runtime.tig_enabled' and a per-region canary set via fleet labels; start with us-west-2 for 1 hour at low traffic then expand; observability dashboards added to monitor tombstone churn and rejoin rate. Backout: flip feature flag off and cleanup reconciler; tombstones are TTL-backed so state will clear automatically. Testing: unit tests for gate logic, integration test simulating rapid rejoin (tests/integration/regional_tombstone_flow.py), k8s smoke deploy with helm chart tweak. Checklist: - [x] design review (ENG-3421) - [x] unit + integration tests - [x] telemetry and alert hooks - [x] canary rollout plan - [x] docs updates for operators (docs/operations/graceful_degradation.md). Technical notes: the TIG uses token-bucket logic scoped per-tenant and per-node to avoid global head-of-line blocking; tombstone is a lightweight lease annotation persisted in the controlplane with eventual consistency to edge proxies to avoid blocking request paths. This is intended as a safety mitigation for short spikes and should not replace longer-term capacity/autoscale actions.

review_conversation:
Marco Ruiz (reviewer): Concerned about race between tombstone TTL and in-flight KV drains — can we ensure tombstone clearance doesn't cause duplicate re-admits?
Sofia Nguyen (author): TIG defers re-admit by a randomized jittered window after TTL expiry; reconciler performs a compare-and-set based clear to avoid races. Added unit tests to prove behavior in edge cases.
Anya Patel (reviewer): Telemetry looks good; request to add a histogram for tombstone durations to help tune defaults.
Sofia Nguyen: Added tombstone.duration histogram and a Grafana panel in the ops dashboard.
Liam Chen (reviewer): CI initially failed on an integration flake (timing). After adjusting wait semantics in test harness the job passed. Approve-by: Anya, Marco. Merge: squash-and-merge after canary smoke passed on us-west-2.
release_notes:
- Hotpatch: add Temporal Isolation Gate to prevent rejoin/evac oscillation under short regional surges.
- Add soft tombstone marker to reduce KV-cache churn during transient quarantines.
- New telemetry metrics and dashboards to help tune quiet-window defaults.
